Container.Name: Smart Gallery for ComfyUI
Container.Overview:
Smart Gallery for ComfyUI.
A fast, beautiful, and mobile-friendly gallery to organize and manage all files generated with ComfyUI, including images and videos in any format. Features full management tools, Workflow Download, Node Summary, and support for nested folders. Works standalone, even when ComfyUI is not running.

Config.Name: ComfyUI input directory
Config.Description: Location to find ComfyUI input data

Config.Name: ComfyUI output directory
Config.Description: Location to find ComfyUI output data

Config.Name: WANTED_UID
Config.Description: UID to use for content in mounted folders (should allow deletion of files)

Config.Name: WANTED_GID
Config.Description: GID to use for content in mounted folders (should allow deletion of files)

Config.Name: THUMBNAIL_WIDTH
Config.Description: Width (in pixels) of the generated thumbnails

Config.Name: WEBP_ANIMATED_FPS
Config.Description: Assumed frame rate for animated WebP files

Config.Name: PAGE_SIZE
Config.Description: Maximum number of files to load initially before showing a Load more button

Config.Name: BATCH_SIZE
Config.Description: Number of files to process at once during database sync

Config.Name: BASE_SMARTGALLERY_PATH
Config.Description: Target for SmartGallery directory mount, do not modify

Config.Name: BASE_INPUT_PATH
Config.Description: Target for ComfyUI input directory mount, do not modify

Config.Name: BASE_OUTPUT_PATH
Config.Description: Target for ComfyUI output directory mount, do not modify
